in_marathi.name: Nokul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's weapon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nokul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nokul is a name derived from the Sanskrit and Hindu traditions, which refers to Lord Shiva's weapon, the trident. The name is deeply rooted in mythology and represents the power and strength of the divine deity.
